items.headline: Banks struggle to digest mounting AI data-center debt; Oracle CDS implies >20% five-year default risk
items.note: Oracle-linked credit derivatives pricing material default risk and banks holding unplaced AI debt signal real distribution stress.

items.headline: AI debt issuance drops ~80% to $23B in September; ~$18B Oracle New Mexico data-center loans trade below par
items.note: Sharp issuance freeze plus sub-par Oracle project loans point to syndication difficulty and a closing funding window for AI buildouts.

items.headline: KKR warns on ~$600B AI debt pile, about 6% of the US IG market, with interconnected issuers
items.note: A large private-credit player flagging concentration and interlinkage risk in AI credit exposure.
